card.name: Digit zero inside numbers and codes
card.fires_on: The digit 0 (or sometimes a stray letter like o) sitting at the start of a number or code, such as a date, ZIP code, study name, or decimal percentage.

modes.label: Zero in study and place codes
modes.description: A leading 0 inside a trial name or ZIP code.

modes.label: Zero starting a decimal or date
modes.description: A 0 before a decimal point or in a day or month of a date.

card.plain: It fires on a zero that begins a number, like a date, ZIP code, trial name or decimal.
